summary: This is a Form 8-K filed by NVIDIA Corporation to report the completion of a large multi-tranche debt offering. On June 18, 2026, NVIDIA issued $25 billion aggregate principal amount of notes across seven series (2028-2056 maturities, coupons ranging 4.250%-5.625%) under its existing shelf registration. The filing details the underwriting agreement with Goldman Sachs, J.P. Morgan, and Morgan Stanley, and the indenture with Computershare Trust. As a routine debt capital markets transaction by a corporate issuer, this filing is not a special situation.
